payload.blocks: Phase 3 land, and through it phases 2, 4, 5 and 6 (all depend on phase 3).
payload.headline: Widen phase 3's footprint by src/cli/command-registry.mjs (session stop entry only)?

parts.cause: The Node flag registry src/cli/command-registry.mjs (session stop entry, about line 2741) declares only persona, name and reason, with persona and name required, so the CLI refuses --role with exit 4 (unknown flag) before bin/fgos.mjs runs. My earlier question missed this file. No running plan's footprint holds it. The confined route in apps/fgos/src/routing.rs is not needed: the wake door runs the host binary unconfined.

options.cost: One footprint commit by the supervisor plus one unit, about 20 minutes.
options.does: Add src/cli/command-registry.mjs to the plan and phase 3 footprint (the supervisor lands it, as with dece50514); one unit adds a role property to the session stop entry, drops persona and name from its required list, and names --role in its description and examples; then review and land phase 3.
options.gain: Acceptance 4 holds end to end: the wake door really stops a short-role lead.
options.harm: The registry is a shared file; other plans may want it later, and they would wait for this land.
options.label: Widen by command-registry.mjs

options.cost: A follow-up item and a later plan.
options.does: Drop the bin/fgos.mjs edit, land phase 3 with the outcome values only, and open a backlog row for the short-role stop.
options.harm: Real wakes still fail to stop a short-role lead (recorded as stop-failed, not blocking); acceptance 4 is met only in fixtures.
options.label: Land without the --role flag

parts.recommendation: Widen by src/cli/command-registry.mjs: it is the last file between the flag and a real call, and the edit is a few lines in one entry.

scope.allows: Changing the plan's footprint by exactly src/cli/command-registry.mjs and editing only its session stop entry for the --role flag.
scope.forbids: Any other change to src/cli/command-registry.mjs, to bin/fgos.mjs beyond the --role branch, or to other plans' footprints.

parts.what: Following q-myvzcbz3sx, the unit added session stop --role lead:<LANE> in bin/fgos.mjs and the outcomes stopped-finished and stop-failed (branch head-lifecycle-events/p03c, uncommitted in its worktree). Tests pass: head-stop 11/11, fgos-supervision wake 9, definitions 19, watcher 26, portfolio 20, fgos supervision_verbs 25/25. The unit settled blocked: a real call of the new flag never reaches that code.
